args.title: Saltmarsh Foods — Freight Pricing This Quarter (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter is on "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to its blog article and a companion piece.
- Article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/freight): Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
